queries: WITH event_avgs AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM event_avgs) SELECT e.corpeventprx, e.avg_analyst_reports, e.avg_gap, e.avg_gap - o.overall_avg_gap AS gap_vs_event_type_average FROM event_avgs AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Gap means insider ownership percentage minus institutional ownership percentage, calculated for snapshots where both values are present.

alternatives.interpretation: Gap means the absolute percentage-point difference between insider and institutional ownership.
